title: Round Trip on Tape Indices
statement: For every index $i$ among the four work tapes, mapping it to its stack name and then back to a work-tape index returns $i$.
hypotheses_covered: A work-tape index $i$ among the four indices
replaced:
Mapping a work-tape index in $\{0, 1, 2, 3\}$ to its stack name and back returns the
original index.
